job.domain: an HR and finance helpdesk assistant

items.text: Quick question — is the security audit for the payroll vendor scheduled before or after the data migration window in March?

intent.requested_action: confirm timing of the vendor security audit relative to the migration

items.text:
I submitted expense claim EXP-48213 for the Berlin conference last week and it's still showing as pending review, so I'd like to understand what's holding it up.

The receipts are all attached — hotel, train, and the client dinner. One thing that might be an issue: the dinner receipt is in German and the total on it includes a service charge that I itemized separately. If that's what's confusing the automatic checks, let me know and I can re-submit with a note.

Separately, our team is still waiting on the finance chatbot rollout. A few of us were told it would be able to answer questions about claim status directly, but so far it just gives generic links to the policy page. Is that expected during the pilot, or should I raise it with the project lead? I don't want to file a ticket if it's known behavior.

intent.requested_action: explain why the expense claim is pending and clarify chatbot rollout expectations

items.text: For the data migration of employee records into the new HR platform, I need to know whether cost centre codes will carry over automatically or whether we have to re-enter them by department. Our old system had a lot of legacy codes that don't map cleanly to the current chart of accounts, and I'd rather flag that now than fix it after go-live. If there's a mapping template, could you point me to it? I've attached the export from last quarter as a reference for the format we're dealing with.

intent.requested_action: explain cost centre code handling in the migration and share a mapping template

items.text: Does the security audit cover the expense tool's API integrations, or only the core HR system?

intent.requested_action: confirm scope of the security audit

items.text: My expense claim for the data migration workshop got rejected for missing a receipt — can I appeal that?

intent.requested_action: ask about appealing a rejected expense claim

items.text:
I'm preparing the audit evidence pack and want to make sure I'm reading the requirements correctly.

Here's the current status of what we've gathered so far:

| Item | Owner | Status |
|------|-------|--------|
| Access review export | Priya Raman | Done |
| Encryption config screenshots | Tom Aldridge | Pending |
| Migration data-flow diagram | Me | In progress |
| Vendor SOC 2 report | Procurement | Requested |

A couple of questions. First, do the encryption screenshots need to be timestamped, or is a plain export fine? Second, the data-flow diagram for the migration is taking longer than expected because the legacy payroll extract touches three systems that nobody fully documented. If that's going to block the audit timeline, I can produce a simplified version first and a detailed one later.

Also, someone on the audit team mentioned that an automated tool scans the evidence folder for completeness before the reviewer sees it. Is that true? If so, I want to know what format it expects filenames in so we don't get flagged for something trivial.

intent.requested_action: clarify audit evidence requirements and timeline options

items.text: Can you confirm whether the migration freeze applies to expense submissions too, or just to master data changes?

intent.requested_action: clarify scope of the migration freeze

items.text: I need to add a second approver to expense claim EXP-48099 since my manager is on leave — what's the process?

intent.requested_action: ask how to add a second approver to an expense claim

items.text: The data migration cutover is this weekend and I'm trying to close out open expense claims before the freeze. Most of mine are approved, but two are stuck in the queue because the cost centre on them belongs to a team that's being merged. I've asked the finance chatbot twice about reassigning them and it keeps telling me to contact my cost centre owner, who is the person whose team is being merged, so that's a bit circular. Is there a manual override I can request, or should I just wait until after cutover and resubmit?

intent.requested_action: find out how to resolve expense claims tied to a merging cost centre before cutover

items.text: Following up on the security audit findings from last month: three of the five medium-severity items are now closed, and the remaining two both relate to the expense system's single sign-on configuration. The vendor says the fix is scheduled for the next maintenance window, which is after our migration date, so I'd like advice on whether to accept the risk temporarily or delay the migration. I've attached the vendor's remediation plan for context.

intent.requested_action: advise on accepting risk versus delaying migration
